related_work_section_raw_text_note: Extracted verbatim from the PDF via pdftotext -layout, section 5 (§5 RELATED WORK), organized into 3 paragraphs matching domain_subtopics.
resolution_methodology: Each entry was first located as a verbatim quote in the anchor paper's own References section (extracted via pdftotext) to confirm the exact author list and title as printed in the paper. Entries that could not be confidently disambiguated this way were then cross-checked against the anchor paper's actual citation graph on Semantic Scholar (GET /graph/v1/paper/arXiv:2410.17891/references, 98 records), matching by first-author surname + publication year (+/-1, since S2's `year` field is often the arXiv-posting year rather than the venue-publication year the in-text citation label uses, e.g. 'Lin et al. (2023)' for a paper S2 dates 2022 but DBLP records as ICML 2023). Every 'resolved' entry below was verified against at least one of these two sources; entries still marked unresolved had no confident match in either source.
